dataset_provenance: Cross-domain training. PlantVillage (controlled lab) + PlantDoc (CC BY 4.0, in-the-wild) mapped onto the original 38-class PlantVillage label space; optional web-collected external test images. See ml/crop_health/evaluation/cross_domain_results.json for the full experiment matrix.
notes: Field-robust model trained with cross-domain evaluation. In-domain lab accuracy is reported separately from in-the-wild accuracy; the app must keep presenting results as screening support, not a definitive diagnosis.
